description: Always reports the value 1; a marker metric whose tags expose the MCP protocol version negotiated during the initialize handshake (protocol_version) and the server's self-reported name (server_name) and version (server_version). Use it to track which protocol and server versions are running across your fleet.
The number of tools the MCP server currently exposes, as reported by its tools/list response.
The number of resources the MCP server currently exposes, as reported by its resources/list response.
The number of prompts the MCP server currently exposes, as reported by its prompts/list response.
The time the MCP server took to complete the initialize handshake during this check run.
The time the MCP server took to respond to a catalog list request during this check run. The capability tag identifies which list was called: tools, resources, or prompts.
The number of JSON-RPC error responses the MCP server returned during this check run. The jsonrpc_method tag identifies the request that failed and the error_code tag holds the JSON-RPC error code.

Counts how many times a catalog's size changed between consecutive check runs (for example, a tool being added or removed). The capability tag identifies which catalog changed: tools, resources, or prompts.
